title: The War Outcome
description: The fighting has stopped. Eight thousand dead. Fourteen thousand wounded. Four hundred million VK in damage. Whatever the outcome — victory, stalemate, or defeat — the country must reckon with what the war cost.

title: The Precipice
description: The Krone has lost forty percent of its value. The IMA program is either working slowly or failing spectacularly. The question is whether your government survives the judgment.

title: Budget Allocation — Reconstruction or Austerity
description: The war is over — or the economy has collapsed — or both. The budget must shift from crisis management to whatever comes after. Reconstruction. Austerity. Reckoning. The treasury needs a direction.

title: Diplomatic Endgame — Peace Terms
description: Armistice negotiations have begun. The terms will determine borders, reparations, war crimes tribunals. Every word in the agreement will be contested. Every concession will be remembered.

title: Tomas — The Park Bench
description: He's been waiting. The park where you taught him to ride a bicycle. The sweater you gave him. He said he'd wait as long as it took. The question is whether you show up.
